rules.statement: Only the owner of a hive may link a scale to that hive.
rules.subject: scale link requester

rules.statement: A scale already linked by another member cannot be linked by a different member.
rules.subject: scale ownership

rules.statement: A weight reading must be a finite, non-negative number of kilograms.
rules.subject: weight reading kilograms

rules.statement: A swarm is suspected when the hive's weight has dropped from its peak within the swarm window by more than the swarm drop threshold.
rules.subject: hive weight drop

rules.statement: No new swarm alert is raised if the scale already alerted within the swarm window.
rules.subject: time since last swarm alert

evidence.quote: return when >= at - INSPECTION_BEFORE_MS && when <= at + INSPECTION_AFTER_MS;

rules.statement: A swarm alert is suppressed when the hive was inspected close to the time of the weight drop (within a set window before or after it).
rules.subject: inspection time relative to weight drop
